description: Benchmark corpus for Callback Guard. Each entry's `label` is the result the scanner SHOULD produce: `malicious` files must be held (>=1 finding), `benign` files must pass clean (0 findings). The `code` section lists executable-malware techniques the benchmark needs but that are intentionally NOT shipped as working exploits in this repo; source them from a public test set and drop them in corpus/malicious/code/ (see corpus/README.md).
